Maya (FinOps): Quick triage for late-ingest spike — saw ~+9% tokens across 3 customers. Need owners: backfill, invoice corrections, recurrence detection, customer comms.
Gabe (Eng): Ill take the backfill. Plan: minimal patch now, simulate backfill on staging tonight, prod backfill tomorrow AM.
Ivy (Metering): Ill add detection rules. Suggest P1: >8% in 2h -> page, P2: >4% in 24h -> slack. Will include a debounce of 2 windows.
Jorge (SRE): Ill handle ledger diff and invoice adjustments script. Need customer CSV from FinOps and approval for pro-rated credits.
Maya (FinOps): Uploaded impact list to FIN-472. Billing-bot queued a reissue job: job_id=br-20240628-01 status=pending.
billing-bot: Reissue job created: br-20240628-01 (FIN-472).
Gabe (Eng): Staging check query:
```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) tokens
FROM token_events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '3 days'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Gabe (Eng): Staging smoke passed; root cause: delayed shard retry. Will add a guard to dedupe processed windows. Backfill schedule set for tomorrow 07:00 UTC.
Ivy (Metering): PR opened: github.com/redwood/meters/pull/439 — dashboards + alerting.
Jorge (SRE): Draft reconcile script at //ops/billing/reconcile_backfill.sh. Dry-run Mon 09:00 UTC.
Maya (FinOps): Owners and timeline recap: Gabe - patch + staging (today), prod backfill (tomorrow 07:00 UTC). Ivy - detection rules + dashboards (Fri AM). Jorge - reconcile script + dry-run (Mon 09:00 UTC). Finance to draft comms after dry-run. Please post status updates here. :thumbsup:
